current_answer: Prove the chain from original capital source to platform, wrapper, instrument, borrower or asset, use of proceeds, operating output, cash durability, risk, and safe claim.
open_question: Can every major claim travel the whole chain without skipping a link?
working_hypothesis: The useful research product is a mechanism map, not a theme label.
answer_mechanism: For each row capture role, wrapper, source, amount, period, use, output metric, bank role, proof level, safe sentence, and disproof test.
boundary: Do not imply the full chain is proven for every company.

current_answer: Capital is visibly reaching named borrowers, grid and power assets, LNG and midstream systems, fleet and collateral pools, backlog-heavy contractors, acquisition platforms, and sponsor-backed operating companies.
open_question: Which dollars are productive capacity versus acquisition, refinancing, liquidity, or control transfer?
working_hypothesis: The cycle is mixed: some capital builds output, some buys assets, some refinances, and some provides flexibility.
answer_mechanism: Classify every destination by use-of-proceeds class and keep same-period totals separate from audit rows.
boundary: Do not treat destination proof as productive-growth proof.

current_answer: Visible wrappers include BDCs, insurers, retirement-linked platforms, public debt investors, ABL and AR lenders, private-credit funds, and bank facilities.
open_question: Can ultimate investor or liability sources be tied to named borrower exposure in the same period?
working_hypothesis: Source proof depends on wrapper type: BDC leverage and equity, insurer liabilities, fund LPs, securitization lenders, noteholders, or banks.
answer_mechanism: Pull vehicle annual reports, statutory filings, prospectuses, leverage notes, funding notes, and adviser disclosures.
boundary: Wrapper visibility is not the same as ultimate-source proof.

current_answer: The Ares borrower layer classifies public BDCs, non-traded BDC/private-credit funds, registered funds, private funds, direct-lending programs, and transaction-context sources.
open_question: Which liabilities or investor bases fund each vehicle's assets?
working_hypothesis: Vehicle identity is mostly solved for the visible holder layer; capital-stack decomposition is the next proof layer.
answer_mechanism: Build vehicle capital-stack rows with assets, debt, notes, NAV/equity, leverage, investor base, adviser, and source visibility.
boundary: Do not allocate vehicle capital to a borrower without same-period bridge evidence.

current_answer: The Ares borrower table has 83 normalized holder/source-taxonomized rows and a 9-row same-period borrower exposure control.
open_question: Are holder rows slices of larger facilities or close to complete packages?
working_hypothesis: Holder evidence is strong for named exposure but weak for full facility size unless reconciled to debt documents.
answer_mechanism: Use credit agreements, amendments, lender allocations, rating reports, and borrower debt notes to reconstruct facility size.
boundary: BDC fair value is not total borrower debt.

current_answer: Private-credit borrower flows are mixed: acquisition finance, consolidation, continued-growth facilities, incremental commitments, transaction-only leads, and selected repayment or termination cases are visible.
open_question: Which flows funded organic growth, capex, refinancing, acquisitions, working capital, rescue, or dividends?
working_hypothesis: Many borrower flows are acquisition/consolidation or refinancing mechanisms rather than clean organic capex.
answer_mechanism: Upgrade with funds-flow language from credit agreements, merger proxies, rating reports, releases, and capex schedules.
boundary: Do not infer use of proceeds from borrower name or sector alone.

current_answer: Selected bank-facility takeout can be proven, while broad bank replacement remains unproven.
open_question: Did banks exit completely or remain through revolvers, agency, treasury, hedging, collateral lending, or securitization support?
working_hypothesis: Private credit often replaces or supplements bank term debt while banks remain in other roles.
answer_mechanism: Search payoff notices, terminations, UCC amendments, lender lists, ratings, administrative-agent roles, and pre/post facility maps.
boundary: Do not say banks are disappearing from corporate lending.

current_answer: URI and Sterling have the strongest operating-conversion evidence; Cheniere has a strong entity/cargo/output bridge; ET has company-level capacity and financing evidence.
open_question: Did financing produce durable output, cash flow, capacity, backlog conversion, utilization, cargoes, rate base, or returns?
working_hypothesis: The best signals appear where capital-flow evidence meets repeated operating conversion evidence.
answer_mechanism: Track revenue, EBITDA, cash conversion, OEC, utilization, MW, cargoes, rate-base additions, backlog burn, project milestones, and customer contracts.
boundary: Proxy-grade output evidence is not project-return proof.

current_answer: Row-level audit evidence, same-period borrower controls, and master-rollup promoted totals are now separated.
open_question: Which number is allowed in each external sentence?
working_hypothesis: Different questions require different denominators and period controls.
answer_mechanism: Enforce row type, period, duplicate, same-period, rollup, and allowed-use fields in generated tables.
boundary: Do not sum mixed-quarter or comparative rows into a current exposure claim.

current_answer: The publication-ready claim register has 15 rows: 14 publication-ready-bounded and 1 internal-only.
open_question: Which claims can move from internal research to external writing?
working_hypothesis: Publication-ready means bounded sentence control, not complete proof of the thesis.
answer_mechanism: Use approved sentence, proof level, evidence route, boundary, forbidden sentence, use condition, contrary-role check, and next-proof fields.
boundary: Do not publish internal-only insurance/retirement source-quality claims yet.

current_answer: The 519-company universe has a role/wrapper/proof extraction template; 71 rows are selected lane-queue candidates.
open_question: Do case-study patterns survive full-universe extraction?
working_hypothesis: The scalable unit is company to role to wrapper to source document to metric to claim strength to missing proof.
answer_mechanism: Run lane-specific extraction batches from the all-company template and promote rows only after primary-source proof.
boundary: This is queue control, not source-grade proof for all 519 companies.

current_answer: The next highest-value work is not more broad collection; it is resolving source, use, facility size, bank role, output conversion, durability, and scale gaps.
open_question: Which proof gap changes the thesis fastest?
working_hypothesis: Bank-role and facility-size upgrades can quickly strengthen or weaken the private-credit replacement answer; output-conversion upgrades can strengthen the investment mechanism.
answer_mechanism: Work the answer-resolution queue, vehicle-stack queue, borrower facility reconstructions, operating-conversion scorecards, and lane-specific 519-company batches.
boundary: Do not let new examples substitute for proof upgrades.

current_answer: All five debt/refinancing pilot rows now have bounded follow-through bridges: Wheaton, Matador, Liberty Broadband, PBF, and Devon each answer a different mechanism question.
open_question: Can any debt/refinancing row be upgraded from company-level bridge to asset-level return or cash-realization proof?
working_hypothesis: The debt/refinancing lane is not one mechanism. It splits into stream funding, borrowing-base credit, holdco restructuring, refining liquidity, and merger-period allocation.
answer_mechanism: For each bridge, extract treasury funds-flow, facility size, lender allocation, covenant/pricing detail, asset-level output, cash return, and debt-service economics.
boundary: Follow-through bridge visibility is not asset-level return proof.
